subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 41, October 3rd, 2026, Not closed yet.
body:

What degraded

  • The deck ships under the bar, at 7.128 after five panel rounds
    The top rung is 8.0 and round 2's was 7.7. Art (median 6.5) and variety (5.5) hold it down: a second Kodiak I-45 deck a week after no. 34, a primitive tractor on frame 3, a mannequin on frame 9, a verge polygon on frame 4 traced to the kit highway, and carton serration on frame 8.
  • No reader action on the deck
    The TxDMV close (no fee, no expiry, the reporting route) was cut in round 1 because carousel no. 34 shipped it seven days ago. The deck now ends on a question the reader can't answer.
  • Slide 2 ships as a 7.4 MB PNG
    Its grass detail can't hold the 40 dB floor as WebP.
  • Scanner ceiling not checked
    No Cloudflare D1 access in this run.
  • One caption pronoun reads loosely
    'It counts more than 1,300 loads...' now follows 'Most of the leg is Interstate 45.' Past the cap only a hard fail may be repaired, so it ships as scored. Edit it to 'Kodiak counts' when posting if you like.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Not closed yet., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Kodiak AI scored itself at 93 percent at the end of August.

The figure is the share of claims and evidence in its driverless safety case the company calls materially complete. It isn't a safety rating.

Kodiak says it closes that case before trucks run unsupervised on the 219 mile leg from Dallas to Houston. It expects both by year end. Most of the leg is Interstate 45. It counts more than 1,300 loads and 750,000 autonomous miles for IKEA over four years, with a safety observer aboard.

Its chief executive says the work left is identified and scheduled, concentrated on final engineering verification and validation.

Kodiak counts more than 3.5 million autonomous miles since 2019. How many ran between Dallas and Houston?

#Interstate45 #KodiakAI #DriverlessTrucks

2. The first comment

The machine changed itself

  • Weekly machine pass, the first: the kit person
    Its cap no longer prints a plank for a bill, long hair falls along the neck when the head bows, and the brows sit on the skin. Judges called the person a mannequin on 4 of the week's 6 decks.
  • week_digest.py stops counting negated mentions
    'No strobe' counted as a strobe. Value strobe drops from 5 runs to 2, so the pass ranks real defects.
  • Accent colour doctrine
    An accent takes its colour from albedo and a small emissive, measured on the probe frame. Decks no. 39 and no. 41 both tuned it across rounds.
  • For a maintainer (human lane)
    Ground contact and dirt (5 of 6 decks) needs the engine, txthree.js. qa.py misreads touching serifs as a canvas rule on two runs, and it lives under .claude/skills. See UPGRADE_BACKLOG 2026-10-03.
  • Twelve items queued for the next pass
    Among them the kit highway's verge polygon, carton serration that isn't shadow resolution, dedupe_check missing a same company same lane deck a week apart, and ship_images.py building og.jpg from the first PNG left in the folder.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

The record. 66 items were due. 57 claims were stamped from their sources, and 23 carry a dated line naming what is unconfirmed. Unreachable blocks were measured today for seven items. tx-2026-0147 (El Paso's plate reader cameras) was rewritten from the council's published September 15th minutes. Two items were admitted: tx-2026-0198, Kodiak naming Interstate 45 from Dallas to Houston its driverless launch lane with its readiness measure and the IKEA leg, and tx-2026-0199, the NSF Sagebrush award. The record holds 172. tx-2026-0036 and tx-2026-0044 go stale tomorrow unless they are read first. The panel. Round 1 found a hard fail: frames 8 and 9 and the caption repeated carousel no. 34's TxDMV close from September 26th. That material was replaced, and frame 8 now carries Kodiak's chief executive on the work left. Round 3 found a comma-pair hedge in the caption, which was split. After round 4 the published-work gate found an untraced 7 on slide 6. Slide 6 now cites c9, and round 5 confirmed no hard fail stands. Medians by round: 6.66, 6.66, 6.76, 6.966, 7.128. Did the run wait on a human. prompt_audit.py exits 1. It measured 1,459 tool calls and counts 474 whose permission decision took longer than its threshold, the longest 30.2 seconds (a Bash call) and the next 21.5 seconds. These waits are consistent with the automatic permission check rather than a person, the same shape the October 2nd run reported. That is not established. No-stall hook: armed at 2026-10-03T06:16:05Z. At session start it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0. It refused nothing. The weekly machine pass ran for the first time, inside this run's pull request. The full account is in runs/carousel/2026-10-03/RUN_RECORD.md.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
